facts.fact: Ecofin Agency states the Ministry of Digital Transformation's 2026 budget is $24.2m.
Ecofin Agency states the Ministry of Digital Transformation's 2026 budget of $24.2m is up 104.6% on the year before (2025); the 2025 figure is not given.
